notes.title: Hotelnomaly now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Finally our first PC game is now available on Steam! lets check it out!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45014787/8850528661d82b880e2164d3af05a1befdbc1f18.png[/img]
[b]Hello fellow mechanic,[/b]

You've been called to fix an elevator in the gorgeous [i]Castela d'Alpine Manor[/i].

[h2]Your job: [b][i]Reach the 10th floor to restore the elevator and[/i] [u]escape safely.[/u][/b][/h2] 
[list][*]Stay vigilant
[*]Inspect every corner for anything out of the ordinary
[*]Check every door
[*]Be brave[/list]

[b]Important:[/b] Every detail counts! Anomalies may show as subtle changes in sounds, objects, images, and lights.

Encounter an anomaly? Hasten back to the emergency stairs.

[h2]Game Description[/h2]
Step into the shoes of a mechanic summoned to fix an elevator in a mysterious 1930s hotel. As you delve deeper into the building's haunted hallways, you'll face eerie anomalies and uncover the dark secrets lurking within. 

Could you finish your job and escape safely?

[h2]Features[/h2] [list]
[*]1930s Hotel Theme
[*]Playtime: 15-30 minutes
[*]3 Endings (Neutral, Bad, Secret)
[*]24 Achievements[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2] [list]
[*]WASD: Move 
[*]Left Click: Interact 
[*]Right Click: Zoom 
[*]Shift: Run 
[*]ESC: Options[/list]

[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
We're excited to hear your thoughts once our game is released! Your feedback will help us enhance the game experience. Honestly, this is our first time making a 3D game, so your future suggestions and feedback will be greatly appreciated in helping us improve. In the meantime, please add our game to your wishlist and stay tuned for updates. Thank you for your interest and support as we prepare for the game's launch!
